text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, the weather's gonna be great on my next day off.
Maybe I'll go do some yoga.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yoga!! That's perfect, I was just thinking
I'd do some ascetic training this upcoming day off!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yoga builds up your core and all that, right?
In that case, want to come with me?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone, let's each do
our favorite yoga pose.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Was there really
a yoga pose like that?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This is my kind of yoga!!
It really feels like training! Plus it increases the workout load!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I don't really know... if this feels like training.
Though coming up with poses does sound pretty cool.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Not yet!
We can get even more fired up~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, perhaps thanks to the yoga (?), Bamboo
Memory managed to get her old figure back.
